definition: thin cloud close to the ground that makes it hard to see far
sentence: A grey {mist} hung over the river at dawn.
translation: На рассвете над рекой висела серая дымка.

definition: a soft bag filled with feathers or foam that you sit or lean on
sentence: She put a {cushion} behind her back and opened the book.
translation: Она подложила подушку под спину и открыла книгу.

definition: a large fish with sharp teeth that lives in rivers and lakes
sentence: A {pike} can grow longer than a metre in this lake.
translation: В этом озере щука может вырасти длиннее метра.

definition: to press something into a smaller space, or to make a file smaller
sentence: The program can {compress} the video to a tenth of its size.
translation: Программа может сжать видео до десятой части его размера.

definition: a very large strong ape with black fur from Africa
sentence: The {gorilla} sat quietly and watched the visitors.
translation: Горилла сидела тихо и наблюдала за посетителями.

definition: a person who makes laws, such as a member of parliament
sentence: Every {lawmaker} received hundreds of letters about the new tax.
translation: Каждый законодатель получил сотни писем о новом налоге.

definition: to become friends again after an argument, or to make two ideas agree
sentence: The brothers did not {reconcile} until their father died.
translation: Братья не помирились до самой смерти отца.

definition: a person who makes a telephone call or visits a place
sentence: The {caller} refused to give his name and hung up.
translation: Звонивший отказался назвать своё имя и повесил трубку.

definition: to fall suddenly, often rolling over
sentence: She tripped on the step and began to {tumble} down the stairs.
translation: Она споткнулась о ступеньку и покатилась вниз по лестнице.

definition: a place where a river falls from a high place over rocks
sentence: We could hear the {waterfall} long before we saw it.
translation: Мы услышали водопад задолго до того, как увидели его.

definition: to leave something out, on purpose or by mistake
sentence: You {omitted} the most important detail from the story.
translation: Ты пропустил самую важную деталь в истории.

definition: to hold and use a weapon or tool, or to have and use power
sentence: The old editor still {wields} great influence in the company.
translation: Старый редактор по-прежнему обладает большим влиянием в компании.

definition: an animal like a small horse with long ears
sentence: A {donkey} carried our bags up the steep path.
translation: Осёл нёс наши сумки по крутой тропе.

definition: a container in which fuel is burned to produce very high heat
sentence: The iron is melted in a {furnace} at over a thousand degrees.
translation: Железо плавят в печи при температуре свыше тысячи градусов.

definition: a person who introduces programmes or reads news on radio, TV or at an event
sentence: The {announcer} read out the names of the winners.
translation: Диктор зачитал имена победителей.

definition: to wait somewhere secretly, usually before doing something bad
sentence: A stranger seemed to {lurk} in the shadows by the gate.
translation: Какой-то незнакомец, похоже, притаился в тени у ворот.

definition: a person who owns the house they live in
sentence: Every {homeowner} on the street received a letter about the new road.
translation: Каждый домовладелец на улице получил письмо о новой дороге.

definition: a man whose job is selling things
sentence: The {salesman} promised the car would last twenty years.
translation: Продавец обещал, что машина прослужит двадцать лет.

definition: a scene in a film or book that goes back to an earlier time
sentence: The film opens with a {flashback} to the hero's childhood.
translation: Фильм начинается с флешбэка в детство героя.

definition: not central or very important, or at the edge of something
sentence: Lighting is a {peripheral} issue; first we need a roof.
translation: Освещение — второстепенный вопрос, сначала нам нужна крыша.

definition: a flat pale nut with a brown skin, often used in cakes
sentence: She sprinkled a chopped {almond} over the cake.
translation: Она посыпала торт измельчённым миндалём.

definition: a form of a language spoken in one area, with its own words and sounds
sentence: The village {dialect} has words no city person understands.
translation: В деревенском говоре есть слова, которых не понимает ни один горожанин.

definition: a member of a group of violent criminals
sentence: The {gangster} controlled every bar in the district.
translation: Гангстер контролировал все бары в районе.

definition: to move in a large crowd, used of insects or people
sentence: Tourists {swarm} into the old town every summer weekend.
translation: Туристы толпами стекаются в старый город каждые летние выходные.

definition: a group of companies or countries that agree to control prices together
sentence: The oil {cartel} cut production to push prices up.
translation: Нефтяной картель сократил добычу, чтобы поднять цены.

definition: to behave in the way that most people do or that rules require
sentence: Teenagers often refuse to {conform} to their parents' ideas.
translation: Подростки часто отказываются следовать представлениям родителей.

definition: an area surrounded by a fence or wall, or something sent with a letter
sentence: The deer live in a large {enclosure} behind the farm.
translation: Олени живут в большом загоне за фермой.

definition: an area of a city with a special use, or a police district
sentence: The new shopping {precinct} has no cars, only walkers.
translation: В новой торговой зоне нет машин, только пешеходы.

definition: a person who has recently arrived in a place or started an activity
sentence: As a {newcomer} to the city, she joined a running club to make friends.
translation: Недавно приехав в город, она вступила в беговой клуб, чтобы найти друзей.

definition: something that mixes two styles or reaches a new audience
sentence: The song was a {crossover} hit on both the pop and country charts.
translation: Песня стала хитом сразу в поп- и кантри-чартах.

definition: the mark left by a foot, or the effect something has on the environment
sentence: We followed a line of {footprints} in the snow to the barn.
translation: Мы пошли по цепочке следов на снегу к амбару.

definition: to become or make less hard, less strict or more gentle
sentence: Leave the butter out to {soften} before you make the cake.
translation: Оставь масло размягчиться, прежде чем делать торт.

definition: a person who is learning something, especially a language or driving
sentence: A {learner} should practise speaking from the first lesson.
translation: Учащемуся стоит практиковать речь с первого урока.

definition: a question that seems impossible but has a clever answer
sentence: Can you solve the {riddle}: what has keys but opens no doors?
translation: Можешь разгадать загадку: у чего есть ключи, но оно не открывает двери?

definition: a period when a person or animal is kept apart to stop a disease spreading
sentence: The dog spent a month in {quarantine} after the flight.
translation: После перелёта собака месяц провела на карантине.

definition: having complete power, used about God, or very big
sentence: In the prayer they thank {almighty} God for the harvest.
translation: В молитве они благодарят всемогущего Бога за урожай.

definition: clothes, especially of a particular type, used in formal language
sentence: The shop sells sports {apparel} for runners and cyclists.
translation: Магазин продаёт спортивную одежду для бегунов и велосипедистов.

definition: the settling of an argument by a person both sides agree to accept
sentence: The dispute over pay went to {arbitration}.
translation: Спор о зарплате был передан в арбитраж.

definition: reddish-brown, used about hair
sentence: Her {auburn} hair shone red in the evening sun.
translation: Её каштановые волосы отливали рыжим в вечернем солнце.

definition: the moment when you start to understand or feel something strongly
sentence: The trip to the factory was a rude {awakening} about how shoes are made.
translation: Поездка на фабрику стала горьким прозрением о том, как делают обувь.

definition: involving two groups or countries
sentence: The two presidents signed a {bilateral} trade agreement.
translation: Два президента подписали двустороннее торговое соглашение.

definition: a fatty substance in the blood that can block the arteries
sentence: The doctor told him to cut fat to lower his {cholesterol}.
translation: Врач велел ему есть меньше жирного, чтобы снизить холестерин.

definition: stylish, expensive and of high quality
sentence: They celebrated at a {classy} restaurant by the harbour.
translation: Они отпраздновали в шикарном ресторане у гавани.

definition: of very high quality and more expensive than the usual kind
sentence: We paid extra for the {deluxe} room with a sea view.
translation: Мы доплатили за номер люкс с видом на море.

definition: the act of removing someone from their job, or of refusing to consider something
sentence: The {dismissal} of the manager shocked the whole team.
translation: Увольнение менеджера шокировало всю команду.

definition: on or to a lower floor of a building
sentence: The kitchen is {downstairs}; the bedrooms are above it.
translation: Кухня внизу, спальни над ней.

definition: the ability to understand and share another person's feelings
sentence: A good nurse needs {empathy} as much as skill.
translation: Хорошей медсестре сочувствие нужно не меньше, чем умение.

definition: possible and likely to be achieved
sentence: Finishing the bridge by June is not {feasible} with this many workers.
translation: Закончить мост к июню с таким числом рабочих нереально.

definition: operated by the pressure of liquid moving through pipes
sentence: The crane lifts the car with a {hydraulic} arm.
translation: Кран поднимает машину гидравлической стрелой.

definition: not able to do something
sentence: After the stroke he was {incapable} of walking without help.
translation: После инсульта он был не в состоянии ходить без помощи.

definition: likely to make people angry, or causing swelling in the body
sentence: The minister's {inflammatory} speech led to protests in three cities.
translation: Подстрекательская речь министра привела к протестам в трёх городах.

definition: serious mental illness, or very foolish behaviour
sentence: Driving on the frozen lake was pure {insanity}.
translation: Ехать по замёрзшему озеру было чистым безумием.

definition: not confident about yourself, or not safe or protected
sentence: He feels {insecure} about speaking English in public.
translation: Он чувствует себя неуверенно, говоря по-английски на людях.

definition: done on purpose
sentence: The foul was {intentional}, and the player was sent off.
translation: Нарушение было умышленным, и игрока удалили.

definition: very strong sexual desire, or a strong wish for something such as power
sentence: His {lust} for power destroyed every friendship he had.
translation: Его жажда власти разрушила все его дружеские связи.

definition: a short sentence that expresses a belief or rule for behaviour
sentence: The school's {motto} is 'Learn today, lead tomorrow'.
translation: Девиз школы: «Учись сегодня, веди завтра».

definition: relating to a person's job
sentence: Back pain is an {occupational} hazard for nurses.
translation: Боль в спине — профессиональный риск для медсестёр.

definition: the moment when something unpleasant begins
sentence: The {onset} of winter came early that year, with snow in October.
translation: В тот год зима наступила рано, со снегом в октябре.

definition: cruel and unfair treatment of a group because of their race, religion or beliefs
sentence: The family fled {persecution} and asked for asylum.
translation: Семья бежала от преследований и попросила убежища.

definition: the liquid fuel used in cars, called gasoline in the USA
sentence: We stopped to fill the tank with {petrol} before the motorway.
translation: Мы остановились заправить бак бензином перед автомагистралью.

definition: now, or soon
sentence: The shop is {presently} closed for repairs.
translation: Магазин в настоящее время закрыт на ремонт.

definition: writing in normal sentences, not in lines of a poem
sentence: Her {prose} is clear and simple, without a wasted word.
translation: Её проза ясна и проста, без единого лишнего слова.

definition: giving off a dangerous form of energy produced when atoms break apart
sentence: The {radioactive} waste is stored deep under the mountain.
translation: Радиоактивные отходы хранятся глубоко под горой.

definition: the moment you understand something, or the achieving of a plan
sentence: The {realization} that she had lost her keys came too late.
translation: Осознание того, что она потеряла ключи, пришло слишком поздно.

definition: the return to friendly relations after a disagreement
sentence: The peace talks were a first step towards {reconciliation}.
translation: Мирные переговоры стали первым шагом к примирению.

definition: relating to dark glasses that protect your eyes from bright sunlight
sentence: The {sunglass} shop on the beach sells cheap copies of famous brands.
translation: Лавка солнцезащитных очков на пляже торгует дешёвыми копиями известных марок.

definition: not completed
sentence: He left an {unfinished} painting on the easel when he died.
translation: Когда он умер, на мольберте осталась незаконченная картина.

definition: bad for your health, or not in good health
sentence: Too much sugar is {unhealthy} for children's teeth.
translation: Слишком много сахара вредно для детских зубов.

definition: not allowed by law
sentence: It is {unlawful} to sell alcohol to anyone under eighteen.
translation: Продавать алкоголь лицам младше восемнадцати незаконно.

definition: disliked by many people
sentence: The new parking fees are deeply {unpopular} with drivers.
translation: Новые тарифы на парковку крайне непопулярны среди водителей.

definition: likely to change suddenly, or quick to become angry
sentence: Oil prices are {volatile} and could double by spring.
translation: Цены на нефть нестабильны и могут удвоиться к весне.

definition: by choice, without being forced
sentence: He left the company {voluntarily} and started his own.
translation: Он ушёл из компании по собственному желанию и открыл свою.

definition: a god or goddess
sentence: The temple was built for the {deity} of the sea.
translation: Храм был построен для божества моря.

definition: to help two sides reach an agreement by talking to both
sentence: A neighbour tried to {mediate} between the two angry families.
translation: Сосед пытался стать посредником между двумя рассерженными семьями.

definition: the wheel or handle used to steer a ship, or the position of control
sentence: The captain took the {helm} as the storm hit.
translation: Капитан встал к штурвалу, когда налетел шторм.

definition: to press something so that it becomes flat or damaged
sentence: Do not {squash} the tomatoes at the bottom of the bag.
translation: Не раздави помидоры на дне пакета.

definition: a system of government with a king or queen at the head
sentence: The country became a republic after centuries of {monarchy}.
translation: После столетий монархии страна стала республикой.

definition: giving a person or animal a substance that protects them from a disease
sentence: The clinic offers free {vaccination} against flu every autumn.
translation: Клиника каждую осень предлагает бесплатную вакцинацию от гриппа.

definition: a small part of something that is left after the rest has gone
sentence: A {remnant} of the old wall still stands behind the church.
translation: Остаток старой стены всё ещё стоит за церковью.

definition: a very large heavy animal with thick skin and a horn on its nose
sentence: The {rhino} charged at the jeep and then stopped.
translation: Носорог бросился на джип, а потом остановился.

definition: an object from the past that has survived, or part of a holy person's body
sentence: The old mill is a {relic} of the town's industrial past.
translation: Старая мельница — реликвия промышленного прошлого города.

definition: the mark left by the pattern of lines on the end of a finger
sentence: Police found a {fingerprint} on the broken glass.
translation: Полиция нашла отпечаток пальца на разбитом стекле.

definition: a group of soldiers living in a town or fort to defend it
sentence: The {garrison} held the castle for three months.
translation: Гарнизон удерживал замок три месяца.

definition: an animal with a flat tail and strong teeth that builds dams in rivers
sentence: A {beaver} had cut down three small trees by the stream.
translation: Бобёр свалил три маленьких дерева у ручья.

definition: a wide open area of high land with rough grass and no trees
sentence: Sheep wander freely across the {moor} above the village.
translation: Овцы свободно бродят по пустоши над деревней.

definition: a small piece of wood or plastic used to fix or hang something
sentence: She hung the wet shirt on the line with a {peg}.
translation: Она повесила мокрую рубашку на верёвку, закрепив прищепкой.

definition: to be a clear example of an idea or quality
sentence: The new library will {embody} the city's belief in learning.
translation: Новая библиотека воплотит веру города в знания.

definition: to walk slowly without lifting your feet, or to mix playing cards
sentence: {Shuffle} the cards well before you deal them.
translation: Хорошо перетасуй карты, прежде чем раздавать.

definition: one of many large rocks that move around the sun
sentence: A small {asteroid} passed closer to Earth than the moon.
translation: Небольшой астероид прошёл ближе к Земле, чем Луна.

definition: strong disagreement with an official opinion or decision
sentence: The government does not allow any {dissent} in the press.
translation: Правительство не допускает инакомыслия в прессе.

definition: one of several regular payments, or one part of a story
sentence: He pays for the car in a monthly {installment} of two hundred euros.
translation: Он платит за машину ежемесячным взносом в двести евро.

definition: a brass musical instrument that you blow into
sentence: He plays the {trumpet} in the town's jazz band.
translation: Он играет на трубе в городском джазовом оркестре.

definition: a famous person's signature, written for a fan
sentence: She asked the singer for an {autograph} on her ticket.
translation: Она попросила певца оставить автограф на билете.

definition: a pig, especially a large one kept for meat
sentence: The farmer sold every {hog} at the autumn market.
translation: Фермер продал всех свиней на осенней ярмарке.

definition: an animal like a large rabbit with long ears and strong back legs
sentence: A {hare} ran across the field faster than the dog.
translation: Заяц пробежал через поле быстрее собаки.

definition: a large wild cat with spotted fur from Central and South America
sentence: A {jaguar} was seen near the river for the first time in years.
translation: Ягуара впервые за много лет видели у реки.

definition: words repeated from a book or speech, or a statement of a price
sentence: The essay opens with a {quotation} from Shakespeare.
translation: Эссе начинается с цитаты из Шекспира.

definition: to raise your shoulders to show you do not know or care
sentence: When I asked where the keys were, he could only {shrug}.
translation: Когда я спросил, где ключи, он лишь пожал плечами.

definition: to shine with small bright flashes of light
sentence: The frost made the whole field {glitter} in the morning sun.
translation: Из-за инея всё поле сверкало на утреннем солнце.

definition: a person in charge of a prison, a park or a college
sentence: The {warden} locked the park gates at sunset.
translation: Смотритель запер ворота парка на закате.

definition: to be a sign of something, or to mean something
sentence: A red light will {signify} that the door is locked.
translation: Красный свет будет означать, что дверь заперта.

definition: to stay strong and not be damaged by something
sentence: These boots can {withstand} rain, snow and mud.
translation: Эти ботинки выдерживают дождь, снег и грязь.

definition: something you must do because of a rule or law
sentence: Helmets are {compulsory} on this bike trail.
translation: На этой велотрассе шлем обязателен.

definition: not normal, different from others, sometimes in an interesting way
sentence: There's a {peculiar} smell coming from the fridge.
translation: Из холодильника идёт какой-то странный запах.
